alt.en: A large gray building stands at the center of a gray floor, between a sheet with abstract code on the left and a seal on the right. Dashed lines connect the sheet to the building and the building to the seal.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央是一座大型灰色建筑，左侧是一张带抽象代码的纸，右侧是一枚印章。虚线将纸、建筑和印章依次连接。

caption.en: Illustration: A building represents the coordination framework, with a proof script on one side and a proof represented by a seal on the other; the diagram does not depict a tested deployment.
caption.zh: 示意图：建筑代表协调框架，两侧的纸和印章分别代表证明脚本与数学证明；此图并非经过测试的部署。
